name: council-build
description: Two frontier advisors plan independently, one synthesizes, a cheap capable model builds, a reviewer from another family checks fidelity, then the build lands.

stages.title: Advisor A: plan for {{goal}}
stages.prompt:
You are one of two independent advisors. Goal: {{goal}}

Read the repository and propose a concrete implementation plan: the files to change, the approach, the risks, and how to verify it. Do not edit anything.

stages.title: Advisor B: plan for {{goal}}
stages.prompt:
You are one of two independent advisors. Goal: {{goal}}

Read the repository and propose a concrete implementation plan: the files to change, the approach, the risks, and how to verify it. Do not edit anything.

stages.title: Synthesize one plan
stages.prompt:
Two advisors proposed plans for: {{goal}}
Their plans are under 'Inputs from finished work'. Merge them into ONE build plan a strong engineer can follow without asking questions: ordered steps, exact files, the done-when test. Where they disagree, pick and say why in one line. Do not edit anything.

stages.title: Build: {{goal}}
stages.prompt:
Implement this goal by following the synthesized plan under 'Inputs from finished work': {{goal}}

Commit your work on the current branch with a clear message. Keep the change focused; run the project's tests if they exist.

stages.title: Fidelity review of the build
